scoring_justification: The scored artifacts are final reported values (alpha and directional Compton profiles); the raw intermediate grids (n_QMC, n_LDA) are not part of the scored output contract, so recomputing from raw is infeasible. Comparison to paper gold with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference alpha value (0.8) and Compton profile anchor points digitized from Fig.6 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.6; digitized using positions reported in the reference solve.sh anchor points.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual digitization from the published figure; values are approximate but sufficient for tolerance-based scoring.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are directly based on the paper's published results; they are not invented. The reference solution oracle reproduces them from the same digitization.

outputs.description: Optimal scaling factor α obtained by minimising the discontinuity cost function for Δn^α. Evaluated using reference_match: your α must be within a hidden tolerance of the reference.

Directional valence Compton profiles J(p) in the [100], [110], [111] crystallographic directions. Evaluated using reference_match: at selected momentum points, absolute deviation from the hidden reference must be within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Both scored artifacts use reference_match (closeness within a tolerance window). The verifier first validates format/schema; missing or ill‑formed files receive zero reward.

steps.description: Check that the reported alpha is within tolerance of the paper's optimum 0.8.
Compare directional Compton profiles at selected momentum points to digitized gold values from Fig.6.
